baseline_models.focus_anchor: The act of extension governs fruit and meat, while the closing desire construction makes the recipients' wanting the selector.
baseline_models.mechanism: Connected addition supplies two concrete food poles and can recur as appetites recur; the recipients specify what fits, but the provider creates and maintains the supply.

activation_trace.role: Connected increase that sustains another makes the verb a continuing supply relation.
Pleasant produce supplies the plant-food pole of the provision.
Feeding meat and supplying game makes flesh provisioned fare rather than a bare substance.
Successive craving makes the demand repeatable and keeps the supply open-ended.

changed_reading.before: A single presentation of fruit and meat.
changed_reading.after: An open-ended provisioning relation that renews concrete food in step with successive desire.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The fruit term can carry both edible produce and the root's state of delighted ease, while flesh and desire join outer food to inner appetite.
baseline_models.mechanism: The menu does not merely occupy space before the recipients; pleasant produce and meat give material form to an inward inclination and its satisfied ease.

activation_trace.role: Pleasant ease and delighted enjoyment supplies the experiential state effected by the food.
Pleasant fruit keeps that experiential activation anchored in the concrete noun.
Bodily fleshiness and appetite tie the second food directly to embodied wanting.
The self's inclination toward a desired object supplies the inward pole to which the foods answer.

changed_reading.before: Two desirable items are added to a heavenly inventory.
changed_reading.after: Outward provision materializes an inward fit: edible pleasure and the recipients' own inclination meet.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Plural recipients receive coordinated foods; remote branches of fruit and flesh activate conversation, adhesion, and kinship around that shared provision.
baseline_models.mechanism: Continued supply sustains a table where pleasant talk and formerly separate persons adhere as kin; desire concerns the quality of shared life as well as private intake.

activation_trace.role: Connected material support gives the shared table continuity.
Pleasant joking and sociable talk turns fruit into a convivial activation without replacing its edible sense.
Joining and adhesion supplies the table's social binding function.
The kinship-bond image specifies what kind of human attachment the shared flesh may support.
Personal inclination remains live inside the collective scene, preventing cohesion from erasing individuality.

changed_reading.before: Several people privately consume the same menu.
changed_reading.after: The supplied table is social infrastructure for individualized pleasure, conversation, and renewed attachment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The four focus roots can be arranged as replenishing flow, emerging produce, thickening crop or flesh, and recurring demand.
baseline_models.mechanism: Water-like replenishment feeds a productive plant-animal system whose fruit, milk, grain, and flesh answer successive appetites; provision is generated rather than drawn from a static pile.

activation_trace.role: Water fed by further water supplies the regenerative flow that powers the model.
Rich milk developing before birth contributes an animal-production stage beside literal fruit.
Grain forming and crop growth contributes a plant-production stage beside literal meat.
Successive requests turn production into a renewable response cycle rather than a one-time yield.

changed_reading.before: A stock of prepared dishes is topped up.
changed_reading.after: A living food system continually fructifies and thickens toward whatever its inhabitants next desire.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same root first predicates delighted enjoyment of the recipients because of a divine gift, then the sequence names trouble-free eating, and only afterward appears as fruit. The food therefore echoes and embodies an already established state.

activation_trace.role: Concrete pleasant fruit remains the grammatical object in the focus.
Delighted ease supplies the experiential resonance carried by that object.
The earlier delighted state explicitly attaches the shared root to the same recipients.
Giving supplies the prior divine transfer that produces their delight.
Ease without trouble or ill effect makes satisfied enjoyment bodily safe.

structural_cues: 52:18 predicates the cognate f-k-h state of the same plural recipients four verses before the focus noun.
52:18-19 moves from gift to delight to harmless consumption before 52:22 extends the supply.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lexical recurrence and sequence; I infer that the later object reactivates the earlier state. The live alternative is that the focus uses only the ordinary fruit noun.

changed_reading.after: Fruit is a material echo of the recipients' already named delighted ease, so provision renews a mode of being as well as food.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, descendants are attached without diminishing anyone's work; shortly after it, the reunited group turns face to face, questions one another, and recalls family life. The supplied meal becomes the maintained medium of a no-loss reunion.

activation_trace.role: Connected increase supplies material continuity without requiring subtraction elsewhere.
Joining formerly separate things makes the meat term resonate with the preceding attachment.
Kinship bond identifies the social relation being materially sustained.
Pleasant sociable talk supplies the activity that fills the reunited table.
Attaching a person to a group supplies the explicit family-joining operation before the meal.
Diminution supplies the loss that the verse explicitly excludes from reunion.
A group facing one another supplies the post-meal social arrangement.
Mutual questioning supplies reciprocal conversation rather than solitary enjoyment.
Nearness and belonging names the family relation recalled in that conversation.

structural_cues: The focus is syntactically placed between descendant-joining in 52:21 and face-to-face family recollection in 52:25-28.
The plural object pronoun remains stable across joining, supplying, circulating service, and conversation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies joining, non-diminution, a plural meal, and later family conversation; I infer that provision maintains the reunion. The alternative is that food and reunion are adjacent rewards with no instrumental link.

changed_reading.before: A shared banquet happens beside a family reunion.
changed_reading.after: A continuously supplied table enacts the reunion: kin are attached without loss and given a durable site for face-to-face memory.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah contrasts aimless play with a cup mutually drawn yet free of futile or incriminating speech. That contrast filters, rather than suppresses, the focus's successive desire and its conversational fruit branch.

activation_trace.role: Successive craving keeps appetite active rather than ascetically erased.
Pleasant joking talk supplies benign convivial expression around desire.
Making sport of reputations supplies the harmful conversational possibility that context excludes.
Aimless action without a sound end supplies the condemned counterfeit of enjoyment.
Mutual pulling supplies active, reciprocal participation in the cup scene.
False or ugly talk names the verbal harm negated from that participation.
Loading another with sin names the moral consequence also negated from the cup.

structural_cues: 52:12 condemns play within false immersion, while 52:23 immediately after the focus retains a shared cup but negates idle and sinful effects.
The focus's desire clause is affirmative and plural, not a deletion of appetite.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the play/cup contrast and explicit negations; I infer that they characterize the social ecology around fulfilled desire. The alternative is that the negations apply only to the cup and do not qualify the food scene.

changed_reading.before: Whatever is desired suggests appetite without an internal limit.
changed_reading.after: Desire remains successive and effective, but its convivial realization is cleansed of futile play, reputational injury, and transferred guilt.

context_deltas.mechanism: The punishment sequence forces bodies toward fire and makes endurance or non-endurance equivalent; the focus instead lets inward inclination determine provision, followed by recipients mutually drawing a cup. Desire acquires causal purchase.

activation_trace.role: Supportive connected increase supplies the external response to the recipients' preference.
The self's inclination supplies an internal selector that now affects what arrives.
Violent pushing supplies the contrasting regime of externally compelled movement.
Meeting the heat of fire supplies the imposed destination of that movement.
Equality between two responses underwrites the surrounding claim that endurance changes nothing.
Mutual pulling supplies a post-focus image of recipients acting together rather than being pushed.

structural_cues: 52:13-16 repeatedly addresses coerced arrival and ineffective response before the garden sequence.
52:22 places desire inside the provisioning clause, and 52:23 immediately gives the recipients reciprocal action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies forced motion, futile response, desire-indexed supply, and mutual action; I infer a reversal from compulsion to effective agency. The alternative is a simple punishment/reward contrast with no special claim about agency.

changed_reading.before: Desire merely selects among menu items.
changed_reading.after: The ayah restores effective agency: inward inclination has causal force in a world contrasted with forced motion and futile response.

context_deltas.mechanism: Work and pledge imagery keep accountability live, but divine release without exchange and the later rejection of wage, liability, and burden prevent each desired item from reading like a charged purchase from a finite treasury.

activation_trace.role: Connected increase supplies abundance as ongoing support rather than a priced transfer.
Successive requests test whether repeated satisfaction accrues cost or depletion.
The wage-of-work image keeps earned recompense genuinely present in the model.
A right secured by a held pledge supplies the surrounding language of personal accountability.
Asking or requesting supplies the later question of whether a wage is being demanded.
Release without compensation supplies a counterweight of unbought favor.
Guarded storage supplies the finite-hoard model that the rhetorical question denies to the addressees.
Binding financial liability names the cost explicitly absent from the focus's request-response relation.
A burdensome load supplies the felt consequence of debt that paradise provision does not impose.

structural_cues: 52:19 links enjoyment to work and 52:21 preserves individual accountability before the focus.
52:27 names divine favor, while 52:37 and 52:40 deny human possession of the treasury and caricature a wage that leaves hearers debt-burdened.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies both recompense language and release-without-price language; I infer that works matter without turning each desire into a purchase. The live alternative is a stricter wage model in which the entire banquet is simply payment.

changed_reading.before: Desired goods are rewards credited against prior work.
changed_reading.after: Provision follows accountability yet remains unpriced and nondepleting: fresh desires incur no new debt and do not expose a finite hoard.

context_deltas.mechanism: Remote context branches furnish revived herbage, abundant water, filling, and an enclosed garden; focus branches add water-fed extension, early milk, and thickening grain. Their inferred causal chain makes the meal an output of habitat-level renewal.

activation_trace.role: Water continuously fed by other water supplies the habitat's replenishing input.
Rich milk developing before birth contributes renewable animal yield beside literal fruit.
Grain forming and vegetation thickening contributes renewable plant yield beside literal meat.
Successive craving converts those yields into a demand-responsive cycle.
Dry herbage revived by rain supplies the dormant-to-productive transition.
Vast abundant water supplies the scale of the imagined resource flow.
Filling with water supplies saturation rather than a dwindling reservoir.
A garden enclosed by vegetation supplies the productive habitat immediately preceding the banquet.

structural_cues: The opening sequence contains spreading and a filled sea; 52:17 then places the recipients in gardens before 52:22 names food.
The focus coordinates plant and animal foods under one replenishing verb.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the material images but not their causal order; I infer water to revived growth to garden yields to desired food. The alternative is that these are unrelated branch resonances around a literal banquet.

changed_reading.before: Prepared foods are replenished from an unspecified store.
changed_reading.after: The garden itself behaves as a regenerative habitat whose plant and animal yields keep answering desire.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus verb's reinforcement branch and the later negation of aid form a positive-negative pair. Fruit and meat can therefore function as visible material evidence that these recipients belong to a supported company.

activation_trace.role: Reinforcing people with food or helpers makes provision a concrete mode of support.
Kinship bond supplies the relational company held together by that support.
Aid that makes one prevail supplies the support explicitly denied to the contrasting group.

structural_cues: 52:22 positively attributes supply to the divine speaker; 52:46 closes the argument by denying support to the opposing group.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies semantic overlap between reinforcement and aid; I infer that food manifests upheld relationship. The alternative is that the two verbs describe unrelated material and forensic outcomes.

changed_reading.before: Food is one isolated category of reward.
changed_reading.after: Food is the bodily form of being actively supported, in contrast to those for whom aid will not arrive.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses food into textual craft; it remains anchored in the focus's inkwell-supply, weft, sociable-talk, and successive-request branches and in the opening written-spread sequence. Render it only as a material analogy, never as a replacement for the food sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Ink-supplying extension, woven flesh, pleasant discourse, and successive requests coexist as remote branches of the four focus roots.

activation_trace.role: An inkwell feeding a pen supplies the mechanism of provision generating another mark.
The weft of cloth supplies an interlacing operation parallel to composing ordered provision.
Pleasant discourse supplies the content that can unfold around the shared table.
One request after another supplies successive prompts to the imagined composition.
Ordered letters and the written object supply explicit textual craft in the opening frame.
An aligned written row supplies the next-line structure of the analogy.
A spread written document supplies the image of provision opening into legible succession.

changed_reading.before: The meal consists only of consumed objects.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, each desire acts like a prompt whose next line or thread is supplied into an unfolding banquet.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The wound-closing sense of flesh is form-distant and makes this reading unusual; it remains anchored in the focus's flesh and sustaining-supply roots and is activated by fear, protection, and penetrating heat nearby. Render it as a somatic repair analogy, not a claim that the meat noun denotes a wound.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The meat root includes flesh closing over a wound, while the supply and delight roots can sustain the movement from injury toward ease.

activation_trace.role: A wound taking on flesh and closing supplies the embodied repair mechanism.
Connected material support supplies what allows repair to continue.
Pleasant ease supplies the repaired body's resulting state.
Care mixed with fear supplies the remembered condition from which repair proceeds.
Protection that repels harm supplies the transition from exposure to safety.
Penetrating hot wind supplies the bodily threat against which closing flesh becomes resonant.

changed_reading.before: The recipients are protected and then separately fed.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, feeding is the bodily completion of protection: threatened flesh is sustained, closed, and brought into ease.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is deliberately dark because it activates killing-into-flesh and fire-feeding branches around an ordinary meal; the explicit meat and supply still anchor it, while the punishment-to-banquet sequence makes the reversal inspectable. Render it only as a qualified contrast of consuming and being exposed to consumption, not as the focus's primary meaning.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Supplied meat can retain a remote memory of flesh produced through killing even while functioning as safe nourishment.

activation_trace.role: Killing until the slain becomes flesh supplies the suppressed violence behind the edible object.
Literal edible flesh keeps the violent activation attached to the actual food noun.
Supportive food supply reverses flesh from an image of destruction into nourishment.
Kindling fire and treating something with heat supplies a dark culinary homology in the punishment scene.
Feeding a fire supplies the consume-or-be-consumed polarity that the safe meal reverses.

changed_reading.before: Punishment by fire and the later meat meal are unrelated images.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the sequence reverses destructive exposure into protected consumption: flesh arrives as sustaining gift rather than the residue of engulfing violence.

strongest_changes: The f-k-h recurrence in 52:18 turns fruit into a material echo of delighted ease.
The descendant-joining and non-diminution sequence recasts provision as a table that maintains reunited kin.
Forced movement and futile response in punishment are reversed by desire having causal purchase in provisioning.
The cup without futile or incriminating speech preserves appetite while constraining its social consequences.
Water, garden, milk, and thickening-crop branches keep a regenerative-habitat reading live.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's four roots unexpectedly converge across material supply, delighted or conversational enjoyment, flesh as food or bond or weave, and successive desire. Context does not collapse these into one answer; it activates causal, familial, ethical, ecological, supportive, and textual readings that can coexist at different confidence levels.
remaining_uncertainties: The state-object echo in f-k-h may be intended resonance or merely contextual polysemy.
The family sequence may make the meal instrumental to reunion, or may only place two rewards beside one another.
The unpriced-abundance model must remain in tension with the explicit connection between enjoyment and work.
The habitat, repair, consumption-reversal, and inscription models depend on deliberately branch-distant material analogies.
